notes: attempt-1 was exploratory (variable structure, treatment coding, weights; no RESULT lines). Final: OLS via lm(). Study 1 (US wave 1, Israel wave 1): outcome on minority-identity dummies (US: identity_protesters==1 Black; Israel: identity_protesters 1=Ethiopian, 2=Arab) and tactic dummies (tactic 1, 2), base white/march, weighted by the survey weight variable. Study 2 US (wave 2): outcome on black, group_goal, commitment, unweighted (no weight variable supplied); police-action regression drops the 5 missing responses (N=3008). Respondent counts are the regression N / data rows. Coefficients, standard errors, intercepts and R2 all line up with the paper's printed Tables 1 and 2. No claim-check attempts were needed; the script was not changed after the first estimating run.
